name: Joint Torque Under Payload
description: Torque at the robot wrist joint under maximum payload. Checks whether rated torque is not exceeded.

elements.name: Peak Wrist Joint Torque
elements.description: Maximum torque during fast pick-and-place motion with rated payload. Uncertain due to trajectory variation.

uncertainty.source: Dynamic simulation with path planning variation

elements.name: Rated Wrist Joint Torque
elements.description: Manufacturer rated continuous torque for wrist joint

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(τ_wrist) = τ_wrist if τ_wrist <= τ_rated, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The rated torque guards the peak wrist torque uncertainty set; torques above the 55 Nm manufacturer limit are excluded.
